topic: Moving Woco data from staging to production
summary_markdown: The conversation focused on deploying changes for the woco project. [me] confirmed that moving from STAGE to PROD could be done at any time, including during a nightly job run. The specific request was to move the data for woco (excluding Finland) from staging to production immediately. This transfer is necessary because a sensor's SL was changed on both environments yesterday, and someone requested the migration.
decisions: Move Woco data from STAGE to PROD
The deployment should exclude data for Finland
action_items: Perform the STAGE->PROD transfer for woco data
